review_evidence: HexMatrix/Certificate.lean defines multiplication and same-lattice certificates and proves soundness/equivalence results including mulEqCert_iff and sameLatticeCert_sound.
The repository owns core matrix operations together with Pad, Diagonal, Region, Gram, Submatrix, DotProduct, Elementary, and algebraic theorem modules.
HexMatrix/Strassen.lean adds an executable matrix-multiplication algorithm within the same proved matrix interface.
summary: Retain hex-matrix as a substantial dependency-free dense-matrix library with verified algebraic operations, certificates, and algorithms.
